facts.fact: On 6 May 2026 the Ministry of the Interior unveiled a digital civil registration platform that is to underpin the country's new civil status system and the production of biometric identity cards; card production awaits adoption of the governing law.
The Ministry of the Interior introduced the platform; its director general for territorial administration put the project's cost at about BIF 15 billion, with no funding source named.

systems.tiers: unveiled 6 May 2026; to underpin the new civil status system; no offices named
technically ready to produce cards; awaiting the law; every citizen to re-register

note: The article is chiefly about the identity card; it does not say what the civil registration platform records, where it runs or how the record is made.
